q: Which materials stay safe at 34% oxygen?

response.answer: Con base en 6 fuentes de NASA y el modelo físico: riesgo crítico en Lunar Base a 34 % O₂ — límite 16.19 %, propagación ≈ 1.1 mm/s.

widgets.title: What-if · 34 % O₂
widgets.body: Vigorous for PMMA-class solids: p(burn) 1.00, spread ≈ 1.1 mm/s. Flammability limit 16.19 % O₂ → margin +17.81. Buoyancy at 0.165 g feeds the flame ≈ 16.5 cm/s, so ventilation off does not starve it (vigorous).

widgets.title: Materials that burn at 34 % O₂
widgets.body: Predicted to sustain flame (limit below 34 %): PMMA (+17.8, 1.1 mm/s), cotton-fiberglass fabric (+14.8, 5.05 mm/s), silicone (+6.3, 3.62 mm/s), aramid fabric (+1.3, 0.41 mm/s).
